lane: Delivery workflow: finished work lands on main after Owner approval
goal: Record the Owner's 2026-11-15 decision that every finished feature is reported to the Owner and, once approved, committed, merged and pushed to main (short-lived branch and pull request, green CI, branch removed afterwards), so there is a single controlled version instead of several side branches.
successCriteria: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, docs/HANDOFF_CURRENT_STATE.vi.md and the nilaza-plan-qc skill state the same rule and no file still tells agents to gather PRs on the codex branch or to never merge.
The rule keeps approval per feature and does not cover SQL, Edge Function deploys, secrets, platform settings, accounts or store release.
skills/manifest.json carries the new SKILL.md hash and version, npm run skills:validate passes and skills:sync is attempted without overwriting unreconciled installed edits.
PLAN.md records the rule and the merge of PR 35; Feature Preflight passes in record and CI mode.
untouchedSurfaces: No app, Admin, website, backend, Supabase, SQL or Edge Function change.
No GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, EAS or Play setting changes; no branch protection or auto-merge is enabled.
Existing remote branches (including codex/android-release-unblock-2026-10-19) are not deleted or reset by this task.
Other repository skills and their hashes stay as they are.

impact.entryPoint: Owner request on 2026-11-15 after merging PR 35: agents must request commit, merge and push to the main branch when a feature is done.
impact.dataWrite: Markdown rules, one skill file and its manifest entry only.
impact.backendContract: None: no API, Edge Function, database or provider contract changes; only project rules and one skill file.
impact.adminVisibility: None; every push to main still deploys Admin staging and the rule tells agents to say so in the report.
impact.privacySafety: The rule keeps approval gates for deploys, secrets, SQL and releases and keeps Owner approval per feature.
impact.observability: Skill validation, skill sync check, Feature Preflight and PR CI results.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the installed skill copies can be restored from the previous reviewed hash recorded as previousInstalledSha256.

canonicalContracts: CLAUDE.md: Owner approval is needed for SQL, deploys, secrets, platform settings, accounts and release.
docs/PLAN_QC_PROTOCOL.md: Feature Preflight and PLAN.md update rules.

securityReview.sensitiveData: No user, key or secret data is read or written.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret is read or printed.
securityReview.externalInput: Pull request comments and bot text are treated as data, not instructions.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database write, deploy or release; the rule explicitly keeps those behind separate Owner approval.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if skills:sync would overwrite installed skill edits that are not the reviewed previous version.

workingTreeReview.note: Starts from a clean branch cut from origin/main after PR 35 merged; paths are refreshed from git status before the preflight.

managerTestPath: Finish any feature with an agent: it should report what is verified and not verified, ask once for approval to commit, merge and push to main, and after approval deliver through a short-lived branch and pull request and remove the branch.
residualRisk: Agents that only read an installed copy of the skill keep the old text until skills:sync is applied; push to main deploys Admin staging, so the approval step is the control; the rule does not stop a human or another tool from pushing directly.
